subject.title: feat(browser): add secure per-tab copilot panel

question: Should `OpenClawPluginToolContext.toolBindings` become a supported plugin API for browser-copilot run custody, and if so what stable contract and compatibility commitment should it carry?
rationale: The field is exposed to plugin tool factories and therefore establishes a cross-plugin API boundary; source review cannot safely choose its long-term public contract without owner intent.

options.title: Approve a narrow binding contract
options.body: Define the browser binding shape as the supported API, document its ownership and validation rules, and add compatibility coverage before merging.

options.title: Keep bindings internal for now
options.body: Move the browser-specific binding through an owner-private runtime seam so plugin tool context does not gain a new general API.

options.title: Pause for broader SDK design
options.body: Defer the panel until maintainers decide whether typed per-run bindings need a general Plugin SDK model.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow binding contract
recommendation.body: Define the browser binding shape as the supported API, document its ownership and validation rules, and add compatibility coverage before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The related side-panel proposal is identified by this PR as the product-direction basis and 2CB2 is directly involved in the follow-up design discussion.
